settings.name: photo_longest_side
settings.description: The longest side, in pixels, a photo is shrunk to on the phone before it is sent. Read by the consumers that shrink; this module never resizes an image.

settings.name: photos_per_question
settings.description: How many photos one question takes. Read by the consumers that collect photos; this module does not count them.

settings.name: largest_file_bytes
settings.description: The largest upload this module accepts, in bytes. An upload past it is refused.

objects.description: A place documents sit in, and the one fact about who reads them: its audience. The audience is data the host reads; this module never decides who may read.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What the folder is called in a list.

fields.name: audience
fields.description: Who reads the folder: anyone, every person in the organisation, the chosen groups, or staff only.

fields.name: group_ids
fields.description: The chosen groups when the audience is groups. Opaque ids the host owns.

fields.name: created_by
fields.description: Who made the folder, supplied by the mount.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the folder was made.

indexes.name: created
indexes.description: The newest-first ordering every listing uses.

objects.description: The record of one file: what it is called and which version is current. The bytes belong to its versions, and the versions to a byte store.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: folder_id
fields.description: The folder the file sits in. The address decides, not the body.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What the file is called in a list.

fields.name: current_version
fields.description: The number of the latest version; zero before the first upload.

fields.name: created_by
fields.description: Who made the record, supplied by the mount.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the record was made.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When a version was last added.

indexes.name: folder
indexes.description: Listing the files in one folder.

objects.description: One upload of a file. Never edited; a replacement is the next version and the old one stays in the history.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: file_id
fields.description: The file this is a version of.

fields.name: number
fields.description: The version's place in the file's history, counting from one.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name the upload carried.

fields.name: content_type
fields.description: The media type of the bytes, as the uploader declared it.

fields.name: size
fields.description: The number of bytes held, counted by the store.

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: The SHA-256 of the bytes as lower-case hex, computed by the store.

fields.name: storage_key
fields.description: Where the byte store keeps the bytes. Opaque, minted by the store, never read from a request.

fields.name: uploaded_by
fields.description: Who uploaded, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

fields.name: uploaded_at
fields.description: When the upload was recorded.
